title: Loki: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116587)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-116587) affects the loki package, specifically versions prior to 3.5.12-r9. The vulnerability involves the Go JOSE implementation of Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards, including JSON Web Encryption, Signature, and Token standards. The flaw does not impact confidentiality or integrity but results in a high impact on availability. A patch is available in version 3.5.12-r9.
